title: MingCute Screenshot Quality Recovery batch 098
review_goal: Differentiate world variants while carrying three already-stable watch and wineglass records to satisfy the fixed five item batch rule.

items.depicts_observation: Round watch face inside one tall body with straight strap blocks attached above and below
items.context_bias: Use when the interface wants the watch to read as one tall body with the face enclosed by straight strap blocks.
items.ambiguity_note: Do not use for the watch with separate tabs when the face should not float between detached top and bottom pieces.
items.selection_reason: The screenshot encloses the watch face inside one tall body instead of showing separate top and bottom tabs.

items.depicts_observation: Round watch face with one separate top tab and one separate bottom tab outside the circle
items.context_bias: Use when the interface wants the watch to show more distinct tabs above and below the round face.
items.ambiguity_note: Do not use for the tall body watch when the face should not be enclosed inside one continuous case body.
items.selection_reason: The screenshot separates the tabs from the face more clearly than the tall body watch variant.

items.depicts_observation: Wine glass with one rounded bowl on a thin stem above one short base line
items.context_bias: Use when the interface wants a classic rounded wine glass bowl on a stem.
items.ambiguity_note: Do not use for the martini glass when the bowl should not sharpen into one wide V shape.
items.selection_reason: The screenshot uses a rounded bowl instead of the sharper V shaped cocktail glass.

items.depicts_observation: Round world circle crossed by three horizontal latitude bands from top to bottom
items.context_bias: Use when the interface wants the world to read as a globe built from horizontal latitude style bands.
items.ambiguity_note: Do not use for the world map globe when continent shapes should appear inside the circle.
items.selection_reason: The screenshot divides the globe into horizontal bands instead of drawing continent shapes.

items.depicts_observation: Round world circle containing two continent shapes and one small island shape inside
items.context_bias: Use when the interface wants the world to read as a globe with continent land shapes inside the circle.
items.ambiguity_note: Do not use for the striped globe when the planet should not reduce to horizontal latitude bands alone.
items.selection_reason: The screenshot fills the globe with land shapes instead of only horizontal bands.
